Hymn 114: Come unto Him
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: A-flat Major
Composer: Hugh W. Dougall
Lyricist/Text Author: Theodore E. Curtis
Category: Prayer and Supplication

This is hymn number 114 titled "Come unto Him" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in A-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Hugh W. Dougall and the lyrics were written by Theodore E. Curtis.
This hymn is categorized under: Prayer and Supplication.
